This “absence implies not” rule is flawed and could lead to an incorrect conclusion, since AKC may not use that label even for breeds widely recognized as giant (e.g., Leonberger). Excluding other credible sources (e.g., FCI, veterinary/encyclopedic references) further risks derailing the process.
